subject: [AMBER] Adding ions to implicit solvent models

messages.author: Conrad F Li
messages.body:
Hello,
I am new to using Amber. After running saveAmberParams in the tleap, I
received the warning
Warning: The unperturbed charge of the unit (-4.000000) is not zero.
I have seen Amber tutorials using explicit water models which resolved this
warning by adding Na+ and Cl- ions (i.e. addIons mol Na+ 0 and addIons mol
Cl- 0) until the charge was neutralized. However, if I am using an implicit
solvent model (i.e. igb=8), do I still need to neutralize the charge by
adding ions? On a more general note, how would I go about adding ions in
tleap (even if it was not for the sake neutralizing the molecule) for
implicit solvent simulations?
Thank you,
Conrad Li

messages.author: Bill Ross
messages.body:
In leap, > help addonsAlso you've likely skimmed the examples of it in the tutorials?The question of your case has likely been answered before and worst case is covered in the manual, but isn't in my experience. Bill RossAI:
http://phobrain.com/pr/home/view.html
